name: Massachusetts

items.label: Massachusetts taxable income
items.note: After the $4,400 exemption ($8,800 married) and the deduction for up to $2,000 of Social Security and Medicare contributions.

items.label: Massachusetts income tax
items.note: 5%, plus the 4% surtax on income over $1,083,150.

items.label: Paid Family and Medical Leave
items.note: The employee share: all of the 0.18% family leave premium and 40% of the 0.70% medical leave premium.

notModelled: No-tax status and limited income credit for very low incomes
provisional: Surtax threshold of $1,083,150 is the 2025 amount
